sections.heading: Why visit Phuket
paragraphs: Phuket (Southeast Asia) is known for its beach, island and nightlife experiences. Overall it is mid-range — comfortable stays and good food without overspending.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is November to April.

list: Phang Nga Bay and James Bond Island

sections.heading: Insider tip

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Phuket?

faq.a: Fly into Phuket International Airport; direct flights run from several Indian cities.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Phuket?
faq.a: Popular choices: Kata / Karon for families; Patong for nightlife; Kamala for quieter beaches.
